import java.util.*;
public class Cache { record Entry(String value,long expiry){} private final Map<String,Entry> data=new HashMap<>(); public void put(String k,String v,long expiresAt){data.put(k,new Entry(v,expiresAt));} public String get(String k,long now){var e=data.get(k);if(e==null)return null;if(now>=e.expiry()){data.remove(k);return null;}return e.value();} public int size(){return data.size();} }
